purpose: Evidence only; source.json and source_exploration.json own release parameters.
model: Two zero-mean Cartesian Gaussian transverse velocities, component variance k_B*T/m; independent Halton quantile dimensions, no finite-sample recentering or variance/total-energy renormalization.
longitudinal_energy_semantics: The previously requested positive Gaussian 5 eV mean / 1 eV sigma now explicitly describes forward energy along local+x=world+y. Total energy includes added world x/z thermal energy.

sources.title: A Conjoined Rectilinear Collision Cell and Pulsed Extraction Ion Trap with Auxiliary DC Electrodes
sources.support: The trapped population approaches buffer-gas room temperature after about 1.5 ms; extraction simulations use a room-temperature trapped ensemble.
sources.limitation: These are cooled trapped states, not a measured transverse temperature at the upstream inlet. The exact value 300 K is the declared room-temperature reference.
